purpose: Soft structural priors for competition-paper modeling narratives. The policy guides emphasis and equation selection without assuming that every problem has the same number of questions or that a fixed question index must be the core model.
principles: Prefer one coherent modeling spine over independent model showcases for every subproblem.
Treat exploratory or descriptive work as a foundation when it supplies variables, relationships, or constraints to downstream modeling.
Promote a research node to core-model status only when its executed model is both substantive and structurally central to downstream answers.
When a later question inherits upstream predictions, parameters, constraints, or decision variables, describe it as an extension of the upstream model rather than as a brand-new model.
Use the smallest equation set that exposes the model's decision variables, governing relation or objective, and essential constraints; routine estimators and metrics may stay in prose or appendices.
Complexity must be justified by validation evidence, not by presentation value.
